run_gen_additional_summary: run the script to generate alternate summaries for all DCI entries using Llama-2-70b
get_new_summaries: get new captions for a dense captioned image and its masks using a remote language model
thread_entry: process a single DCI index from the queue and update its summaries in the dataset JSON file
review_get_new_summaries: review the get_new_summaries function that generates base and mask-level captions with retry logic
refactor_run_gen_additional_summary: refactor the run_gen_additional_summary function to use a different language model or thread count
